title: Turn Creator Audio Into Searchable Text with ElevenLabs
markdown:
If you are comparing transcription tools for TikTok clips, ElevenLabs’ TikTok transcript generator is designed to accept a TikTok link or an uploaded clip and return speaker-labeled text. Its product page presents the workflow for trend videos, creator clips, and brand content, with editing intended for details such as @handles, brand names, and slang. [Source: https://elevenlabs.io/tiktok-transcript-generator](https://elevenlabs.io/tiktok-transcript-generator)

Check your source material against the supported workflow before deciding. ElevenLabs states that you can paste a TikTok URL or upload MP4 or MOV files; its FAQ also lists AVI and MKV. The page lists exports including TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT, VTT, JSON, and HTML, which may matter if you need a script, captions, an approval copy, or a searchable library. [Source: https://elevenlabs.io/tiktok-transcript-generator](https://elevenlabs.io/tiktok-transcript-generator)

For editing and attribution, the product page says the editor supports corrections, segment splitting or merging, and speaker reassignment. It also describes word-level timestamps, audio-event tags for laughter, music, and applause, and speaker labels for up to 32 speakers. Review whether those stated capabilities fit the way you handle duets, stitches, voiceovers, or clips with several speakers. [Source: https://elevenlabs.io/tiktok-transcript-generator](https://elevenlabs.io/tiktok-transcript-generator)

Language coverage may be another decision point. ElevenLabs says Scribe transcribes 90+ languages and accents without manual switching. If you publish or review clips across markets, confirm that the languages, correction workflow, and export type you need are available for your intended use. [Source: https://elevenlabs.io/tiktok-transcript-generator](https://elevenlabs.io/tiktok-transcript-generator)

For cost planning, ElevenLabs lists a Free plan at $0 per month with 10,000 credits and Speech to Text included. Its pricing FAQ gives an approximate Speech to Text cost of 330 credits per minute and says credits are shared across products. The same page lists monthly plans from Starter at $6 through Business at $990, while noting that prices exclude taxes, levies, and duties. Confirm current plan details and expected minutes before subscribing. [Source: https://elevenlabs.io/pricing](https://elevenlabs.io/pricing)
